definitions.short: Belteshatstsar , the Babylonian name of Daniel
definitions.full: H1095. Belteshatstsar בֵּלְטְשַׁאצַּר proper name, masculine Dan 1:7 , בֵּלְטְאשַׁצַּ֑ר 10:1 (probably = Babylonian balâtƒu-uƒur , protect his life! COT 1:7 Dl in BD Dn. p. ix ; Hoffm ZA 1887, 56 conjecture אצר [ ר ] שׁ בלט Bala‰ ( = good Saturn?) protect the king! — 4:5 connected with Bel , but name then inexplicable), name given to Daniel by Nebuchadnezzar. בְּלִיַּעַל בְּלִימָה, בְּלִי, see below בלה .

occurrences.englishText: The prince of the eunuchs gave names to them: to Daniel he gave the name Belteshazzar; to Hananiah, Shadrach; to Mishael, Meshach; and to Azariah, Abednego.

In the third year of Cyrus king of Persia a thing was revealed to Daniel, whose name was called Belteshazzar; and the thing was true, even a great warfare. He understood the thing, and had understanding of the vision.
